# Seasonal Fun media

The release bundles the author's original Halloween model `marshmallow-animated.glb` and the three accompanying sound files: `laugh.mp3`, `balloon-pop.mp3`, `bubble-pops.mp3`. The supplied transparent St. Martin animation `St_Martin_korrigiert.webp` is used by the scene renderer.

These media files must be committed alongside the source code before release. They are not licensed under the JavaScript MIT license.
